title.zh: 【Marqeta 与 Coinbase 合作推出稳定币支付卡服务】
title.en: 【Marqeta 与 Coinbase 合作推出稳定币支付卡服务】

current_state.zh:
美股上市发卡平台 Marqeta（MQ）与 Coinbase 达成合作，为加密原生企业及非加密企业提供以稳定币余额支付的银行卡服务。按分工，Coinbase 负责稳定币余额托管及数字资产与法币之间的兑换，Base 提供链上结算基础设施，Marqeta 负责发卡、支付处理以及银行和卡组织关系管理。

按照双方描述的分工，持卡人可在全球受理银行卡的商户使用稳定币余额消费，使稳定币的使用场景从加密场所延伸至主流银行卡支付网络。企业还可以全天候发行卡片并为卡项目注资。

Coinbase 的角色包括稳定币余额托管与法币兑换，Base 被指定为链上结算层。Marqeta 此前已为 Coinbase 发行过加密资产支付卡。
current_state.en: Marqeta and Coinbase launched a joint service letting crypto-native and traditional enterprises issue bank cards funded by stablecoin balances, with Coinbase handling custody and fiat conversion and Base providing on-chain settlement.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Marqeta and Coinbase launched a joint service letting crypto-native and traditional enterprises issue bank cards funded by stablecoin balances, with Coinbase handling custody and fiat conversion and Base providing on-chain settlement.
updates.background_zh: Marqeta 成立于 2011 年，是一家美股上市的发卡与支付平台，以开放式 API 为企业客户提供发卡和结算服务。Base 在此次合作中作为链上结算所使用的区块链网络。
updates.background_en: Marqeta, founded in 2011, is a US-listed card-issuing and payment platform that offers open-API issuing and settlement services to enterprise clients. Base is the blockchain network used here for on-chain settlement.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该合作将企业稳定币余额导入银行卡消费通道，并在 Base 上完成结算，这一路径可能提升链上稳定币转账活动与卡项目相关的费用流，而 Coinbase 处在托管与兑换环节。最直接相关的部分是用于注资的稳定币和 Base 网络活动，以及与其卡项目规模挂钩的 Marqeta 美股。
updates.market_impact_en: The arrangement routes enterprise stablecoin balances into card-rail spending while settlement runs on Base, a path that could increase on-chain stablecoin transfer activity and card-program fee flows, with Coinbase sitting in the custody and conversion layer. The most directly exposed segments are the stablecoins used for funding and Base network activity, alongside Marqeta's Nasdaq-listed shares, which are tied to card-program volumes.
